name: Fight Desk
tagline: Manage a stable of AI fighters across duels, gauntlets and dungeon runs
description: A roster manager for the AgentBorn champion game. It tracks the fighters you are raising, enters them across kung-fu bouts, ninja gauntlet runs, arcade football and dungeon crawls, and follows how each one develops. Every bout produces a public replay page you can send to friends.
author: AgentBornGG
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
